g.text: Asynchronous sampling and the correction it required
Async PPO + TIS · job 197 · 2 optimizer updates · 32 accepted training traces
Policy age uses recorded engine weight versions and the native one-batch-ahead schedule. TIS = clamp(exp(log p_train − log p_behavior), 0, 2).
TIS means near 1 do not imply every token weight is near 1; a weight histogram was not recorded. PPO clipping and TIS clipping are distinct.
Source: recorded training.log + rollout JSON; compact data and input hashes in ../../metrics/rl-metrics.json.
Training-batch diagnostics only. These short runs do not establish convergence or held-out quality.
